_comment: Deployed implementations excluded from yarn check:storage-layout, keyed <network>/<DeploymentName>.
An entry only excuses a deployment whose artifact records no layout to compare against. It cannot
suppress a real incompatibility: a target that compares badly fails whether or not it is listed here.
Every entry needs a reason. An entry that starts passing is reported as stale and fails the check,
so this file cannot outlive the problem it documents. Prefer fixing or annotating over adding here.
A deployment that is simply new does not belong here: it is absent from the base ref and passes on its own.

skip.bscmainnet/GovernorBravoDelegator: Artifact is a stub recording only address, abi and numDeployments, so there is no reference layout to compare against. GovernorBravoDelegator is a Compound-style delegator, not a hardhat-deploy transparent proxy, and the stub records 0x360ac19648efc29d2b7b70bac227c35e909272fd, the GovernorBravoDelegate implementation it held in 2023 rather than the one it holds now. The live implementation is whatever the delegator points at, already covered by bscmainnet/GovernorBravoDelegate.
